Your date, design, price and fulfilment arrangements are confirmed directly. An enquiry does not reserve a date or place an order.

A few things you
might be wondering.

How do I make an enquiry?

Use the contact page to put your ideas together, then send your message to @bakedbyadeela on Instagram. Please include your date and the kind of creation you have in mind.

How much notice should I give?

Enquire as soon as you have a celebration date. Availability and the time needed for your design will be confirmed directly before an order is agreed.

Can I choose my colours and flowers?

Share your palette, favourite flowers or inspiration with your enquiry. The final design and what is achievable will be discussed with you.

How much will my order cost?

A personalised quote can be confirmed after the size, design and other details are discussed. This preview does not include a confirmed price list.

Can you accommodate dietary requirements?

Mention any allergies or dietary needs before ordering. Ingredients, cross-contact risks and suitability must be confirmed directly; this website does not promise allergen-free products.

Is collection or delivery available?

Ask about collection or delivery when enquiring. The location, timing, any delivery charge and safe transport arrangements need to be confirmed with Adeela.
